decisions.reason: Placing the ISBN on the copyright page does not change the dedication page content.
The request changes content placement on one specific copyright page, not the general interior layout rules.
ISBN placement on the copyright page does not affect chapter illustrations or their placement and rendering.
The source explicitly targets the copyright page and does not change the interior title page arrangement.
Adding an ISBN to the copyright page does not change page-numbering or table-of-contents requirements.
The ISBN placement decision does not affect chapter-title or subtitle typography.
The copyright-page ISBN request does not alter recurring callout typography.
ISBN placement on the copyright page does not change the typography or artifact rules for the book title.
The client requests ISBN placement on the copyright page only; this does not entail adding, removing, or relocating any cover element.
The copyright-page ISBN placement does not alter back matter or author-copy content.
The source concerns ISBN placement within the manuscript and does not change KDP listing metadata or its delivery format.
Adding the ISBN to the copyright page does not change manuscript copyediting rules or approved prose.
